# Stable Fixtures

These files are the retained grouped-v2 consumer and rejection inputs. They
make the stable specification corpus executable without preserving the retired
plan-structure fixture hierarchy.

## Directory Map

- [cli-conformance/](cli-conformance/README.md) — the portable command-line
  interface assertion manifest and the terms on which this copy is owned here.
- [v0-4/](v0-4/README.md) — grouped-v2 configuration, adversarial fixtures,
  and the acceptance manifest for the stable contract.
